# INSIGNAR

> INSIGNAR is B2B introduction and follow-up software. After an event conversation, the rep records what the person said and INSIGNAR builds a private page about their problem, opened by tapping an NFC / QR card. Pre-launch; UK founding pilot by request.

## Pages
- [Home](/): what it does and how to request a pilot
- [Facts](/facts): plain statements about the product and its stage
- [Digital business card vs introduction software](/vs/digital-business-cards): the difference and when each fits
- [How it works](/how-it-works): what a prospect sees and what is and is not collected
- [Privacy](/privacy): data handling
